subject: general
question: Which among the following is NOT a work to be consulted for the history of Mughal India?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ Shahnameh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Shahnameh **is a long poem composed by the **Persian poet Ferdosi** between the time period of **977 and 1010 CE** and is the national epic of **Greater Iran.**
 
• Shahnameh is one of the two ancient Iranian manuscripts listed on the** United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization's Memory of the World register.**
 
• **Abul-Qâsem Ferdosi Tusi, also Firdausisi**, was a Persian poet and the author of Shahnameh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Shahjahan-nama** is a book in which** written about the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan**. **Padshah-nama is a word for lavishly illuminated versions.**
 
• **Akbar-Nama was composed in Persian**, which is the **written language of the Mughals**. It contains **detailed information about Akbar's life and times.**
 
• **Alamgir-namah ****the history of Emperor aurangzeb (1658-1707) is composed by Mirza Muhammad Kazim.**
 
• By following the tradition of the Mughal emperors from the time of Akbar, **Aurangzeb ordered his court historian Mirza Muhammad Kazim to record and compile the history of his reign.**
